setupCorrections: Installed Chrome requires execution outside the filesystem sandbox.

The second bounded LAN fixture selected a fixed peer row and timed out awaiting an invitation. The final attempt uses the established Phase 9 native guest-ID/open-peer row selection, without changing transport infrastructure. Earlier incomplete attempts remain local and are not counted as a completed LAN pass.

The first bounded LAN session connected successfully, but its assertion assumed a requested profile name and nearby guest spawn. The corrected driver reads the genuine native guest identity and teleports that player into the controlled fixture before entity/ESP checks; no synthetic snapshot is used.

The legacy GUI preamble used a 350 ms held-forward movement assertion on an unprepared saved-world spawn; did not establish displacement at the unprepared saved spawn. The dedicated transition runner omits that unrelated terrain-dependent assertion; controlled movement already passes the full suite.

A test-only diagnostic referenced the intentionally removed native-state global after successful world exit; changed it to window.__eaghacksNativeState and reran the transition component. No product change or gameplay suite repetition was required.

The initial GUI continuation timed out at an origin-range fixture. Reopening that disposable save showed the player at y=48 below the y=150 platform. Phase 15 GUI preparation now waits for origin chunks, teleports back onto the platform and asserts grounded y=150 before the reused suite. This invalid continuation is excluded. A later cohort transition exposed a genuine delayed GUI resume race dismissing a fresh user pause; the source fix has a failing-before regression and final-byte native verification. Preliminary candidate evidence is archived locally and excluded from final RC4 counts.

targetedReview.performance: No performance concern observed. Changes affect held-input gating; no simulation/render algorithm changed. No performance comparison or optimization certification claimed.

remaining: Seven physical LAN checks; repeated invitation/reconnect reliability remains outside verified scope after the bounded timeout
reproductionNotes: Use fresh task profiles for a fresh full run. Existing evidence is hash-bound. Native LAN discovery/server helpers are preserved local upstream test infrastructure, not new product dependencies. Keep raw diagnostics local.
